thread:
sophie: Quick sync — finalizing announcement cadence for the Dedicated launch. Need: 1) final changelog link 2) docs + examples link 3) canary timing for rollout 4) benchmark blurb and who owns the webinar demo. Can someone confirm?

devin: Changelog is up-to-date, pushed to GH release notes. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/tag/v2.1.0 (please use this canonical). Canary is scheduled 03/25 08:00 PST for internal + 10% external traffic.

maria: Got it, thanks. I'll slot the blog post for 03/26 morning. Can we get a one-paragraph benchmark summary we can quote? Need numbers and testing config.

devin: Benchmark blurb: "v2.1 reduces p99 latency by ~22% at 2k concurrent sessions vs v2.0 on A100-40GB; cost per 1k tokens down ~18% via improved batching and KV caching." Test config: 8-token prompt warmup, 512 max tokens, synthetic convo trace. Use that?

ash: Minor note — call out quantized variant in the post for cost numbers. Suggest: add a parenthetical: (quantized 4-bit profile used for cost comparisons).

lee: Docs + examples are staged at https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v2.1/examples — I updated the quickstart snippet for streaming and function calling. Please link to the migration guide as well: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v2.1/migration.

maria: Webinar — who can demo the live load test and show latency + token billing dashboard? We need 20–30min slot, live Q&A.

devin: I can run the live load test and have the infra dashboard open. Would like someone from product to narrate the customer impact. ash, can you take the product walkthrough?

ash: Yep I can. Plan: 10min product, 10min demo (devin), 10min Q&A. Who handles registration + lead routing?

maria: I'll own registration. For inbound lead routing: route enterprise interest to the sales/AE queue, any technical evals -> solutions-eng. I'll wire up Zapier to SFDC: tag = "v2.1_launch". Any custom fields we should capture?

lee: Capture "deployment_type" (hosted/dedicated/private) and "priority_sla" — useful for Dedicated leads.

maria: Perfect. Marketing will include a short GA form with those fields.

announce-bot: Canary rollout: 10% public traffic at 2023-03-25T15:00:00Z. Fallback policy: auto-retry to v2.0 on p95 error > 2x baseline for 10m.

sophie: Awesome. Action items: devin confirm benchmark numbers in a single-paragraph PR to marketing by EOD today; lee confirm docs links are final; ash + devin rehearse demo Monday; maria will publish blog 03/26 and set up registration funnel. If anyone needs to change dates, flag now. :thumbsup:

devin: Will post blurb in this thread and ping when it's updated.

maria: I'll create the webinar calendar invite and include the rehearsal link.

lee: Docs links final, migration note added.

sophie: Great — thanks team.
